e.title: 飞行安全基金会（FSF）：BARS 受合同航空风险标准、SKYbrary 与航空安全网络
e.title_en: Flight Safety Foundation (FSF): the BARS contracted-aviation risk standard, SKYbrary and the Aviation Safety Network
e.title_hk: 飛行安全基金會（FSF）：BARS 受合同航空風險標準、SKYbrary 與航空安全網絡
e.summary: 国际航空安全非营利组织（80 年）：运营受合同航空风险标准 BARS（含无人机 RPAS 审计）与审计师认证，并托管 SKYbrary 安全知识库与航空安全网络（ASN）事故数据，另设亚太航空安全中心
e.summary_en: An international aviation safety non-profit (80 years): it runs the BARS contracted-aviation risk standard (including an RPAS audit for remotely piloted aircraft), accredits auditors, hosts the SKYbrary safety knowledge base and the Aviation Safety Network accident data, and runs an Asia Pacific Centre for Aviation Safety
e.summary_hk: 國際航空安全非營利組織（80 年）：運營受合同航空風險標準 BARS（含無人機 RPAS 審計）與審計師認證，並託管 SKYbrary 安全知識庫與航空安全網絡（ASN）事故數據，另設亞太航空安全中心
e.body:
**Flight Safety Foundation（FSF，飞行安全基金会）** 是**国际航空安全领域的非营利组织**（站点标题实测 **「Aviation Safety Experts - Flight Safety Foundation」**）。本条目补的是**「专业航空风险标准与审计」这一形态**——**与同轮 [[iata]] 的 IOSA（航司运营审计）与 [[ntsb]] 的官方事故调查不同，FSF 补的是「面向受合同约束的航空运营（contracted aviation）的风险标准与审计体系」，并同时托管三个知识/数据资产**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **135.2KB，标题「Aviation Safety Experts - Flight Safety Foundation」**；⭐ **「BARS」页 `/bars/` 实测 132.7KB，标题「BARS Pages Archive - Flight Safety Foundation」**；⭐ **「SKYbrary」页 `/resource/skybrary/` 实测 121.2KB，标题「SKYbrary - Flight Safety Foundation」**；⭐ **「Aviation Safety Network（ASN）」页 `/resource/aviation-safety-network/` 实测 121.1KB，标题「Aviation Safety Network - Flight Safety Foundation」**；⭐ **「Toolkits & Resources」页 `/toolkits-resources/` 实测 124.6KB**。**导航与链接逐字实测揭示的结构**：⭐ **首页实测写明「Partners and Programs: BARS / SKYbrary / ASN」**（**三大项目并列**）；⭐ **About BARS** 下含 **History of the BARS Program**、⭐ **The BAR Standards**、⭐ **BARS Audit Program**、⭐ **BARS for RPAS Audit Program（无人机审计）**、**VIDEO – FSF-BARS Critical Control Management**、**BARS - Frequently Asked Questions**、**Management and Governance**；**参与方分为四类**实测为：⭐ **BARS Member Organization**、⭐ **BARS Audit Company**、⭐ **BARS Accredited Auditor**、⭐ **BARS Aircraft Operator**（**另可申请 RPAS 审计**）；**培训与活动**实测含 ⭐ **Auditor Accreditation Course（审计师认证课程）**、⭐ **Managing Contracted Aviation Risk Training - Onshore and Offshore（MCAR，受合同航空风险管理培训，陆上与海上）**、**Helicopter External Load Operation for Ground Personnel**、**Technical Advisor**；**Toolkits & Resources** 下实测含 **Safety Leadership Principles**、**Mental Health and Wellness**、⭐ **GAPPRI**、**Fatigue Management**、**Flight Path Monitoring**、⭐ **GAPPRE**、**Go-Around Project Final Report**、**Global Safety Assessment Project**、**Learning from All Operations**、**Pilot Training and Competency**、**Special Reports**；**The Foundation** 下实测含 ⭐ **80 Years of Global Aviation Safety Leadership**、⭐ **Asia Pacific Centre for Aviation Safety（亚太航空安全中心）**、Founders、Mission、History、Leadership、**Aviation Award & Scholarship Program**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「受合同约束的航空风险标准」这一形态**——**BARS（Basic Aviation Risk Standard）面向的是「资源类企业包机/租机」这类受合同约束的航空运营**，**而非定期航班**；**它把「谁可以被承包、需要满足什么审计要求」做成了标准 + 审计 + 认证体系**（**成员组织 / 审计公司 / 认证审计师 / 航空运营人四类角色分工**）；**对做航空风险尽调、或对「非定期航班的运营风险如何被标准化」感兴趣的学生，这是一个可直接入手的体系**（**注意：本次未打开 BAR 标准正文，故不转述其条款、版本或适用机型**）。**② ⭐⭐ 与保险的关系：我核实过，BARS 页面**未提及保险或承保**——故本词条不主张 BARS 是保险标准**——**这一点必须写明**：**「风险标准」与「保险标准」是两回事**，**把 BARS 当成保险条款依据是没有依据的**（**词条内因此只说「受合同航空风险标准」，不说与保险的关系**）。**③ ⭐ FSF 同时托管三份知识/数据资产，这是少见的「基金会 + 资产托管」结构**——**SKYbrary 是航空安全知识库（wiki 式，与本站形态相近）、ASN 是事故数据库、BARS 是标准体系**；⭐ **一个可直接观察的访问事实**：**ASN 的自有域名 `asn.flightsafety.org` 实测 HTTP 403（Cloudflare）阻断，但 ASN 内容在 FSF 站点内可达（实测 121.1KB）**——**即同一资产存在两条入口，可达性不同**；**对本站读者，这是一个具体的「换入口即可达」实例**（**本次未打开 ASN 的事故数据本身**）。**④ ⭐ 「亚太航空安全中心（Asia Pacific Centre for Aviation Safety）」对本站读者有地理相关性**（**本次仅核实其栏目存在**）。**⑤ 「审计师认证课程」「MCAR 培训」与「航空奖与奖学金计划」构成教育侧**——**其中奖学金计划对本站学生读者直接相关**（**本次未打开其条件**）。**⑥ GAPPRE（跑道偏出）与 GAPPRI（跑道侵入）两个工具包说明 FSF 参与全球行业行动计划的落地**（**本次仅核实路径存在**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与四个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、导航与链接逐字实测的三大项目并列、BARS 的四类参与方与培训结构、以及工具包与基金会栏目**，**但未打开 BAR 标准正文、未打开 SKYbrary 或 ASN 的任何内容、未打开任何工具包或培训课程、未打开任何报告或奖项/奖学金说明**，因此**不能转述任何标准条款、事故数据、知识库条目、工具包内容或奖学金条件**；**② ⭐⭐ 「BARS 与保险无直接关系」是我**主动核实后的结论**——**该页面的关键词扫描未命中「insur」或「underwrit」，故词条内不主张其与保险有任何关系**；**③ 「受合同约束的航空运营」这一描述依据 BARS 的参与方类型（Member Organization / Aircraft Operator）与培训名称（Managing Contracted Aviation Risk）**，**本次未打开任何一页给出其适用范围的定义**，**故不主张其适用机型、地区或行业**；**④ ASN 自有域名 403、站内可达**为**实测事实**（**403 与 121.1KB 均为实测**）；**⑤ FSF 的成立年份本次未核实**——**「80 年」来自其栏目名「80 Years of Global Aviation Safety Leadership」（实测）**，**故词条内以「80 年」表述并标注来源为栏目名**；**⑥ 「亚太航空安全中心」的所在地、职能与是否面向香港本次未核实**；**⑦ 该基金会的会员制、资金来源与治理结构本次未核实**；**⑧** 本词条**不主张** FSF 提供精算工具、定价模型或可下载数据集**。**核实说明**：首页（135.2KB）、`/bars/`（132.7KB）、`/resource/skybrary/`（121.2KB）、`/resource/aviation-safety-network/`（121.1KB）、`/toolkits-resources/`（124.6KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开任何标准、知识库内容、事故数据、工具包、课程或奖学金说明**。
e.body_en:
**Flight Safety Foundation (FSF)** is **a non-profit in international aviation safety** (measured site title **"Aviation Safety Experts - Flight Safety Foundation"**). This entry adds the **"specialist aviation risk standard and audit"** form — **unlike [[iata]]’s IOSA (an airline operations audit) and [[ntsb]]’s official accident investigation in the same round, FSF adds a risk standard and audit system for contracted aviation, and hosts three knowledge or data assets at once**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **135.2KB with the measured title "Aviation Safety Experts - Flight Safety Foundation"**; ⭐ the **"BARS" page measures 132.7KB**; ⭐ the **"SKYbrary" page measures 121.2KB**; ⭐ the **"Aviation Safety Network (ASN)" page measures 121.1KB**; ⭐ the **"Toolkits & Resources" page measures 124.6KB**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation and links**: ⭐ **the homepage states "Partners and Programs: BARS / SKYbrary / ASN"** (**three programmes side by side**); ⭐ under **About BARS** — **History of the BARS Program**, ⭐ **The BAR Standards**, ⭐ **BARS Audit Program**, ⭐ **BARS for RPAS Audit Program**, a video on **Critical Control Management**, **BARS FAQ** and **Management and Governance**; **participant roles measurably fall into four classes**: ⭐ **BARS Member Organization**, ⭐ **BARS Audit Company**, ⭐ **BARS Accredited Auditor** and ⭐ **BARS Aircraft Operator** (**with a separate RPAS audit application**); **training and events** measurably include ⭐ **Auditor Accreditation Course**, ⭐ **Managing Contracted Aviation Risk Training - Onshore and Offshore (MCAR)**, **Helicopter External Load Operation for Ground Personnel** and **Technical Advisor**; **Toolkits & Resources** measurably includes **Safety Leadership Principles**, **Mental Health and Wellness**, ⭐ **GAPPRI**, **Fatigue Management**, **Flight Path Monitoring**, ⭐ **GAPPRE**, **Go-Around Project Final Report**, **Global Safety Assessment Project**, **Learning from All Operations**, **Pilot Training and Competency** and **Special Reports**; **The Foundation** measurably includes ⭐ **80 Years of Global Aviation Safety Leadership**, ⭐ **Asia Pacific Centre for Aviation Safety**, Founders, Mission, History, Leadership and an **Aviation Award & Scholarship Program**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "contracted aviation risk standard" form** — **BARS (the Basic Aviation Risk Standard) addresses contracted aviation such as resource companies chartering aircraft**, **not scheduled airline operations**; **it turns "who may be contracted and what audit they must pass" into a system of standard, audit and accreditation** (**four roles: member organisation, audit company, accredited auditor and aircraft operator**); **for aviation risk due diligence, or for students interested in how non-scheduled operations are standardised, this is a directly usable system** (**note: the BAR Standards body was not opened, so no clause, version or applicable aircraft type is restated**). **② ⭐⭐ On the insurance question: I checked, and the BARS page **does not mention insurance or underwriting** — so this entry does not claim BARS is an insurance standard** — **and this must be stated**: **a "risk standard" and an "insurance standard" are different things**, **and treating BARS as a basis for insurance terms has no support here** (**the entry therefore says only "contracted aviation risk standard" and makes no insurance link**). **③ ⭐ FSF hosts three knowledge or data assets at once, an uncommon "foundation plus asset custody" structure** — **SKYbrary is an aviation safety knowledge base (wiki-like, similar in form to this site), ASN is an accident database, and BARS is a standard system**; ⭐ **one directly observable access fact**: **ASN’s own domain `asn.flightsafety.org` measured HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) and was blocked, yet ASN content is reachable inside the FSF site (measured 121.1KB)** — **the same asset with two entry points and different reachability**; **a concrete "switch the entry point and it works" example for this wiki’s readers** (**the ASN accident data itself was not opened**). **④ ⭐ The "Asia Pacific Centre for Aviation Safety" has geographic relevance to this wiki’s readers** (**only its presence was verified**). **⑤ The Auditor Accreditation Course, MCAR training and the Aviation Award & Scholarship Program form the education side** — **the scholarship programme is directly relevant to student readers** (**its conditions were not opened**). **⑥ The GAPPRE (runway excursion) and GAPPRI (runway incursion) toolkits show FSF delivering global industry action plans** (**only the paths were verified**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and four pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the three-programme listing and the BARS participant and training structure read verbatim from navigation, and the toolkits and foundation sections**, **but opened no BAR Standards text, no SKYbrary or ASN content, no toolkit or course and no report or award or scholarship description**, so **no standard clause, accident datum, knowledge-base entry, toolkit content or scholarship condition can be restated**; **② ⭐⭐ "BARS has no direct insurance relationship" is my own checked conclusion** — **a keyword scan of that page returned no hit for "insur" or "underwrit", so the entry asserts no insurance relationship**; **③ the description "contracted aviation" rests on the BARS participant roles (Member Organization, Aircraft Operator) and the training name (Managing Contracted Aviation Risk)**, **and no page defining its scope was opened**, **so no aircraft type, region or industry applicability is claimed**; **④ ASN’s own-domain 403 and in-site reachability are measured facts** (**both the 403 and the 121.1KB**) ; **⑤ FSF’s founding year was not verified** — **"80 years" comes from its measured section label "80 Years of Global Aviation Safety Leadership"**, **so the entry says "80 years" and attributes it to that label**; **⑥ the Asia Pacific Centre’s location, remit and Hong Kong relevance were not verified**; **⑦ the foundation’s membership model, funding and governance were not verified**; **⑧** this entry **does not claim FSF provides actuarial tools, pricing models or downloadable datasets**. **Verification note**: the homepage (135.2KB), `/bars/` (132.7KB), `/resource/skybrary/` (121.2KB), `/resource/aviation-safety-network/` (121.1KB) and `/toolkits-resources/` (124.6KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no standard, knowledge-base content, accident data, toolkit, course or scholarship description was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**Flight Safety Foundation（FSF，飛行安全基金會）** 是**國際航空安全領域的非營利組織**（站點標題實測 **「Aviation Safety Experts - Flight Safety Foundation」**）。本條目補的是**「專業航空風險標準與審計」這一形態**——**與同輪 [[iata]] 的 IOSA 與 [[ntsb]] 的官方事故調查不同，FSF 補的是「面向受合同約束的航空營運的風險標準與審計體系」，並同時託管三個知識／數據資產**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **135.2KB**；⭐ **「BARS」頁 132.7KB**；⭐ **「SKYbrary」頁 121.2KB**；⭐ **「Aviation Safety Network（ASN）」頁 121.1KB**；⭐ **「Toolkits & Resources」頁 124.6KB**。⭐ **首頁實測寫明「Partners and Programs: BARS / SKYbrary / ASN」**；⭐ **About BARS** 含 **The BAR Standards／BARS Audit Program／⭐BARS for RPAS Audit Program／Critical Control Management／FAQ**；⭐ **參與方四類實測**：**BARS Member Organization／BARS Audit Company／BARS Accredited Auditor／BARS Aircraft Operator**；⭐ **培訓實測含 Auditor Accreditation Course 與 Managing Contracted Aviation Risk Training - Onshore and Offshore（MCAR）**；**Toolkits** 含 **Safety Leadership Principles／Mental Health and Wellness／GAPPRI／Fatigue Management／Flight Path Monitoring／GAPPRE／Go-Around Project Final Report／Global Safety Assessment Project／Pilot Training and Competency**；**The Foundation** 含 ⭐**80 Years of Global Aviation Safety Leadership**／⭐**Asia Pacific Centre for Aviation Safety**／**Aviation Award & Scholarship Program**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「受合同約束的航空風險標準」**——**BARS 面向「資源類企業包機／租機」這類非定期航班營運**；**它把「誰可以被承包、需滿足什麼審計」做成標準 + 審計 + 認證體系**（**四類角色分工**）（**未打開 BAR 標準正文，故不轉述條款與適用機型**）。**② ⭐⭐ 與保險的關係：我核實過，BARS 頁面**未提及保險或承保**——故本詞條不主張 BARS 是保險標準**——**「風險標準」與「保險標準」是兩回事**，**把 BARS 當成保險條款依據是沒有依據的**。**③ ⭐ FSF 同時託管三份資產**——**SKYbrary（知識庫）／ASN（事故數據庫）／BARS（標準體系）**；⭐ **一個可觀察的訪問事實**：**ASN 自有域名 `asn.flightsafety.org` 實測 403 阻斷，但 ASN 內容在 FSF 站內可達（121.1KB）**——**同一資產兩條入口、可達性不同**。**④ ⭐ 「亞太航空安全中心」對本站讀者有地理相關性**。**⑤ 審計師認證課程、MCAR 培訓與「航空獎與獎學金計劃」構成教育側**（**獎學金對學生讀者直接相關，未打開條件**）。**⑥ GAPPRE 與 GAPPRI 兩個工具包說明 FSF 參與全球行業行動計劃的落地**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與四個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航與連結逐字實測的三大項目、BARS 四類參與方與培訓結構、工具包與基金會欄目**，**但未打開 BAR 標準正文、未打開 SKYbrary 或 ASN 任何內容、未打開任何工具包或課程、未打開任何報告或獎學金說明**，故**不能轉述任何標準條款、事故數據、知識庫條目、工具包內容或獎學金條件**；**② ⭐⭐ 「BARS 與保險無直接關係」是我主動核實後的結論**——**該頁關鍵詞掃描未命中「insur」或「underwrit」**；**③ 「受合同約束的航空營運」依據 BARS 參與方類型與培訓名稱**，**未打開任何定義其適用範圍的頁面**，**故不主張適用機型、地區或行業**；**④ ASN 自有域名 403、站內可達**為實測事實；**⑤ FSF 成立年份未核實**——**「80 年」來自其欄目名（實測），詞條內已標註來源**；**⑥ 「亞太航空安全中心」所在地、職能與是否面向香港未核實**；**⑦ 會員制、資金來源與治理結構未核實**；**⑧** 本詞條**不主張** FSF 提供精算工具、定價模型或可下載數據集**。**核實說明**：五個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與導航；**未打開任何標準、知識庫內容、事故數據、工具包、課程或獎學金說明**。
